title: Not very magical!
text: Not very magical!. The unicorn is a little scary looking and also has teeth! The chop sticks are a little wobbly. They do not store closed and tend to get stuck in drawer because they are always in open position. Still, they are unicorn chopsticks and my 7 year old is thrilled.

product_metadata.title: Genuine Fred Shark Munchtime Chopsticks, One Size, Multi-Color
features: FUN & FUNCTIONAL: These are chomping chopsticks with biting action. Take a bite out of your lunch with MUNCHTIME shark chopsticks. They make every meal jawsome
CLEVER DESIGN: The shark opens and closes its mouth as you squeeze the easy-to-use, hinged chopsticks. They're perfect for kids (or adults.) who are trying to learn how to use chopsticks
MEALS MADE EASY: MUNCHTIME chopsticks provide entertainment that helps even the fussiest eaters make it though a meal. Mix it up with MUNCHTIME.
QUALITY MATERIALS: All MUNCHTIME shark chopsticks are made of durable, food-safe ABS plastic. The reusable style is a great, and environment-friendly alternative to traditional bamboo chopsticks
GREAT FOR GIFTING: MUNCHTIME chopsticks make a great stocking stuffer or an addition to an animal themed party. These are a must have gift for any shark lover... kids and adult alike.
